name: smart-form-fill
title: Smart form fill
description: A paste-to-fill form card where AI reads an email signature or rough notes and fills the contact field by field with a confidence dot, lights up each value's source in the pasted text, flags low-confidence guesses for review, and Undo restores the old values.

name: enrich-column
title: Enrich column
description: An AI enrichment column for a data table where one prompt runs down every row, each cell shimmers while it works, then settles into a value with its source or a failure you can retry, with a footer tallying what's done.

name: ticket-router
title: Ticket router
description: A support ticket router where messages from Gmail, Intercom, Slack and Zendesk come in one at a time. An AI classifier labels each one with intent, sentiment and confidence, and the ticket moves into a team lane with an assignee. Low confidence tickets wait in a review lane, and one click there routes them to the suggested team.

name: ask-your-data
title: Ask your data
description: A natural language to chart card: you ask a question, PostgreSQL streams into a collapsible, syntax highlighted panel, the query runs with a rolling row count, and the answer builds as stacked bars, lines or a table, with a one line insight streamed in underneath.

name: agent-cursor
title: Agent cursor
description: A live document where Claude edits like a collaborator: its labeled cursor comes out of its avatar, selects a paragraph and streams in a rewrite, adds a heading and fixes a typo, while a teammate's cursor reads along. Changes stay tinted until someone accepts or undoes them from a floating review bar.

name: provider-status
title: Provider status
description: A status card for the AI providers your product depends on. Each row shows the provider's real mark, its health as an icon and label, p50 latency and a 30-day uptime bar with a tooltip for each day. An incident row expands into its timeline of updates, and the card checks again on a visible countdown.

name: training-run
title: Training run
description: A fine-tuning job card where a live train and validation loss curve draws across a fixed step axis that doubles as the epoch progress bar. It shows the learning rate, elapsed time and ETA, the latest evals and checkpoints, has Pause and Cancel while it runs, and ends in results with a Deploy button.

name: ai-command
title: AI command
description: A Cmd+K command palette with an AI mode: type to search pages and actions, or press Tab to ask your workspace — the answer streams into the fixed-height panel with numbered citations that highlight their source chips, and suggests next steps you can run right there (create a Linear issue, open a Notion doc) with running, done and retry states. Gliding highlight, combobox/listbox semantics, polite live region, reduced-motion fallbacks and a self-playing walkthrough that stops at first real interaction.

name: ai-spark
title: AI spark
description: An animated four-ray brand mark that shows what your AI is doing: it breathes while idle, ripples while thinking, pulses like a heartbeat while writing, gathers when done and dims on error — every status change blends from the pose the mark already occupies. Ships in three variants (bare mark, bordered pill with a live crossfading label, avatar tile), self-plays with no status for demos, respects prefers-reduced-motion and announces state changes through a polite live region.

name: starter-prompts
title: Starter prompts
description: An empty-state panel for AI apps: a greeting, category tabs (All plus yours), and a 2x2 grid of starter prompt cards. Shuffle deals a fresh page of suggestions with a staggered crossfade; picking a card fills the composer below it, Enter sends (Escape aborts in flight), and app-connected cards carry their app mark (Gmail, GitHub, Notion, Linear, Google Calendar). Ships with 24 sample starters, a loading skeleton in the cards' own rhythm, roving-tabindex tab navigation and a polite live region announcing picks, shuffles, sends, aborts and errors.

name: ai-mascot
title: AI mascot
description: A live SVG mascot that shows what your assistant is doing: idle breathes, floats and blinks; listening leans in with wide eyes; thinking tilts its head while a companion dot orbits around it, passing behind and in front of the body; writing looks down as the dot draws a line under it; done squints happily and the dot becomes a sparkle; error shakes once with worried brows. The eyes follow the pointer on a damped spring, every status change blends from the pose currently on screen over 420 ms, it self-plays through all states when status is unset, freezes into clean static poses under prefers-reduced-motion and can announce state changes through a polite live region.

name: image-reveal
title: Image reveal
description: An image generation canvas where a soft, blurred preview built from the image's own downsampled colors sharpens behind a fine latent-noise layer as the sampler steps, then a tiled VAE-style decode snaps the crisp image in over the frozen last frame, finished by one soft light sheen. Ships a translucent progress pill (spinner + Denoising + n / 30 with tabular numerals), a calm queued state with a 2.6s seam-free shimmer, an error state with optional Retry, seeded per-step noise so batch tiles differ, reduced-motion fallbacks, and auto-simulation mode with staggered queue, hold and loop for grids.
